maya: Hey — noticed structured tool args are coming back malformed in the INT8 GPTQ batch run. Only happens when we use batch size > 1 and AWQ packing enabled. Example bad output from model:

```
request tool_call args expected: ["/tmp/foo.txt", 42]
model emitted: "[\"/tmp/foo.txt\", 42]"
```

maya: So the args array is being returned as a single quoted JSON string instead of as an array, which breaks our tool runner. Repro steps: run batch_bake_2026 with model `redwood/gpt-small-quantized-int8` + awq_pack: true, seq_len 512.

liam: ack. do you have the raw model output (tokenized) for one sample? curious if there's an extra quote token or a leading space.

maya: pasted one tokenized line below — you can see a stray `"` token between the array start and filename.

```
... 91 34 91 34 47 116 109 112 47 102 111 111 46 116 120 116 34 44 32 52 50 93 34 ...
tokens -> " [ " / t m p / f o o . t x t " , 4 2 ] "
```

maya: seems like the quantized model emits an extra \" token at the end, so postprocessing glues it and we end up with a quoted string. Happens ~7% of calls in this batch. Not seen on fp16 baseline.

eva: sounds like a KV-cache / prefix alignment issue under AWQ packing. We saw similar escape-quote artifacts in earlier fp8 experiments but only with certain pack alignments. Can you run with `awq_pack: false` and `continuous_cache: true` to confirm?

maya: did that — with pack:false it's clean. With pack:true it's flaky. Also repros with AWQ-int8 and GPTQ-int8 variants, but not fp16.

liam: can you run a short bisect: vary batch size 1..8 and set `pack_chunk: 64/128/256` and log whether the extra \" appears? I can throw a quick script on the runner.

qa-bot: job run/quant-batch-bisect-1767504321 started by liam — link: https://ci.internal/runs/quant-batch-bisect-1767504321

maya: thanks. quick mitigation for services — we'll pre-accept string args: if tool arg is a string and looks like a JSON array, call json.loads on it before invoking tools. Not ideal but avoids outages.

eva: filing a tracker: ENG-ML#4387 — "AWQ pack: emitted extra quote token causing funcall arg stringification". Assign to runtime team. Also add a test in schema-fuzz that asserts arrays are emitted as arrays for 1000 prompts.

liam: TODOs: 1) run bisect job, 2) add transient json.loads mitigation in tool-runner, 3) add unit test to spec suite, 4) schedule runtime deep-dive.

maya: will open PR for mitigation and attach sample token dumps.

liam: thx — ping here when bisect completes or if the CI job shows high failure rate. :mag:
thread_summary: Batch inference with AWQ packing causes quoted JSON arrays in funcall args; repro matrix, short mitigation (pre-parse JSON), CI bisect job started, tracker created for runtime team.
